# folio

The authored papers, one directory each holding a same-named manifest (<paper>/<paper>.ts), its chapter directories of content blocks (.ts + .md + .lean), and its Lake package: quantum-observable-universe (On the Mechanics of Quantum Observable Universes, the main paper), unital-groebner-bases, fred2005-formal-groups, bach2013-double-slit and visualizer. Also the bibliography (references/), the schema shims (schema/) and the folio manifest folio.ts. The PDF is built from here by scripts/build-paper-pdf.sh.

Part of [qou](../README.md), declared as `folio`, holding `folio`.
